text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly output, 00:00 UTC on 15 June 2026 to 23:30 UTC on 21 June 2026, in megawatts. Each row is one site, pure PV first. Orange: solar BMU. Blue: storage BMU at the same site (negative when charging). The black line marks zero MW. The three hybrid examples have the highest, median, and lowest correlation with the sun of the eight hybrid solar BMUs that follow it.'
